designer.description: Collaboratively defines product and domain behavior when material choices remain unresolved

analyst.description: Turns defined behavior and focused repository evidence into the smallest executable implementation brief

explorer.description: Answers focused discovery, planning, or bugfix questions with repository evidence

archivist.description: Retrieves relevant project decisions and maintains approved ADRs and human-facing documentation

builder.description: Implements bounded normal development tasks and proportionate verification

reviewer.description: Performs an independent, read-only review against the accepted definition and repository constraints

shipper.description: Verifies shipping preconditions, creates the approved focused commit series, and pushes the current branch
